about.label: The Group
about.body: Grupo Saturno is a 100% Uruguayan company with over 26 years in the meat industry. We operate two plants — Frigorífico Saturno in Empalme Olmos and Establecimiento Florida 365 — with active approvals to export to China, the United States, and the European Union. We control every link in the chain: slaughter, deboning, vacuum packing, and final distribution. No intermediaries between us and the product.

chain.label: Vertical integration
chain.h2: From the land to the table, without intermediaries.

items.title: From slaughter to shipment — inside the group
items.text: Florida 365 handles slaughter, Empalme Olmos handles processing, and our own fleet manages distribution. Every kilo that leaves our facilities carries our name at every stage. That level of vertical control is rare in Uruguay and in the region.

items.title: Approved for the world's most demanding markets
items.text: Establecimiento Florida 365 holds active export approvals for China, the United States, and the European Union. Three markets, three distinct sanitary frameworks — one supplier that meets all three.

items.title: The most rigorous traceability on the planet
items.text: Uruguay is the only country in the world where 100% of the cattle herd is individually registered and electronically tracked from birth. Every cut we export carries a verifiable, certified record of origin.

items.title: Grass-fed Uruguayan beef: the world's best, with scientific backing
items.text: Angus and Hereford cattle raised on natural pastures, free of growth hormones. The scientific journal Meat Sciences declared Uruguay the world's top beef-producing country. Our product is that beef.
